steps.name: Given I am on the HOME page
When I clock in the timesheet with PIN "2463"
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('2', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('4', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('6', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('3', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title') }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'CONFIRM', exact: true })
Then I should see the employee "Isabella" in the employee list
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
When I add the "Acrylic removal" service to my cart
And I select the service "Acrylic removal" in my cart
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
When I select the "GIFT CARD" category
Then I should see the "Gift card $50" service
When I add the "Gift card $50" service to my cart
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Activate Gift Card $50.00"
And I click on the "OK" button in the popup dialog
And I click on the "ADD ON" button in the popup dialog
Then I should see my cart showing 2 item added
And I should see the service "Gift card $50 (1703)" in my cart
When I pay the exact amount by "Cash"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')

Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'OK', exact: true })
Expect "toBeHidden" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
When I select the "CLOSED TICKET" tab
And I wait for the page fully loaded
And I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the first ticket of payment "$77.5"
When I reopen to void ticket with payment amount "$77.5"

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$77.5' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$77.5' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()

Click locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$77.5' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
And I should not see the employee "Isabella" in the ticket list
